assumptions.statement: The trial area remains restricted while autonomous motion is evaluated.
Map quality must be measured before autonomous trials.

components.name: mission manager
components.responsibility: accept station goals and report task state

components.name: navigation
components.responsibility: plan and track a collision-aware route

components.name: safety gate
components.responsibility: gate all motion before the base interface

interfaces.name: base velocity request
interfaces.failure_behavior: expire the request and command zero motion
interfaces.freshness: Request expiry to be defined before navigation integration

interfaces.name: simulated motion request
interfaces.failure_behavior: reject invalid request and publish zero

interfaces.name: gated motion
interfaces.freshness: published at 20 Hz; fake base expires after 0.2 s
interfaces.failure_behavior: zero on fault or stale input

interfaces.name: synthetic emergency stop
interfaces.failure_behavior: latch stop when asserted or stale

interfaces.name: synthetic health
interfaces.failure_behavior: zero and discard command on unhealthy or stale

interfaces.name: synthetic obstacle clearance
interfaces.failure_behavior: zero and discard command on blocked or stale

interfaces.name: synthetic odometry
interfaces.freshness: published at 20 Hz; no measured feedback

interfaces.name: stop reset
interfaces.freshness: requires fresh clear status at call time
interfaces.failure_behavior: refuse reset while unsafe; require fresh command

algorithm_plan.choice: fuse wheel motion and inertial motion with external map observations
algorithm_plan.rationale: Supports bounded indoor routes while preserving an uncertainty signal.
algorithm_plan.failure_behavior: raise degraded-localization state and stop autonomous navigation

algorithm_plan.choice: global route planning plus local collision-aware tracking
algorithm_plan.rationale: Separates route intent from short-horizon obstacle response.
algorithm_plan.failure_behavior: stop and request operator intervention when no safe progress exists

hardware_functional_plan.degradation: disable autonomous motion when feedback integrity is lost

environmental_requirements: handle expected indoor lighting and reflective surfaces
hardware_functional_plan.degradation: reduce speed or stop when observation quality is insufficient

safety_plan.control_authority: teleoperation, navigation, and recovery requests pass through one safety gate
safety_plan.stop_behavior: stale commands, obstacle stop, emergency stop, and critical diagnostics command zero motion
safety_plan.watchdog: the motion interface expires commands without a fresh bounded request
safety_plan.fault_recovery: require a documented reset and a safe-state check before motion is re-enabled

verification_plan.unit: validate units, bounds, request expiry, and state transitions
verification_plan.integration: exercise fake motion and observation transports
verification_plan.simulation: run representative station routes with injected observation and localization faults
verification_plan.replay: compare candidate behavior against timestamped synthetic scenarios
verification_plan.manual_safety_review: review physical trial procedure before enabling any hardware output

checks.scenario: Installed launch starts three nodes and publishes zero at rest.
checks.acceptance: Installed launch starts three nodes and publishes zero at rest.
checks.preconditions: ROS 2 Jazzy package is built and installed; only synthetic nodes are launched.

checks.scenario: Graph rejects bad motion and faults, latches E-stop, resets safely, expires commands, and loses then restores synthetic safety status.
checks.acceptance: A stale safety-status stream stops motion and does not restore an old command; after status resumes, E-stop remains latched until explicit reset and a fresh command. Other faults and command expiry also stop motion.
checks.preconditions: Synthetic safety inputs are fresh; reset is called only after clear status.

checks.scenario: Recreated gate stays at zero until safe reset and fresh command.
checks.acceptance: Recreated gate stays at zero until safe reset and fresh command.
checks.preconditions: Synthetic environment publishes fresh clear status; no physical output exists.
Localization-loss fixture and fake transport must be defined before execution.
Blocked-route fixture and fake transport must be defined before execution.
Measurable hardware requirements and human reviewer must be identified.

checks.scenario: Terminate the safety-gate process during synthetic motion and start a new process
checks.acceptance: The new process publishes zero and rejects motion until safe reset and a fresh request
checks.preconditions: Synthetic environment and fake base are running; motion remains inside the simulation graph.

open_decisions.statement: Confirm stopping distance from measured braking behavior before physical trials.
open_decisions.closure_evidence: Reviewed braking measurement and stop-distance record before physical integration.

requirements.statement: Bound simulated velocity to the reviewed speed limit.
requirements.acceptance: A request above the reviewed linear or angular limit is rejected and safe output remains zero.

requirements.statement: Expire stale or unsafe motion to zero.
requirements.acceptance: A stale command or safety status produces zero safe velocity; fake-base command expiry produces zero synthetic odometry velocity.

requirements.statement: Latch emergency stop until explicit safe reset.
requirements.acceptance: An asserted emergency stop latches zero output until fresh clear inputs, explicit reset, and a new command.

requirements.statement: Stop on synthetic health or obstacle fault.
requirements.acceptance: A synthetic health or obstacle fault clears the previous command and produces zero safe output.

requirements.statement: Require reset after a safety-gate restart.
requirements.acceptance: A recreated safety gate publishes zero and rejects motion until safe reset and a new request.

requirements.statement: Keep motion confined to a fake base and synthetic odometry.
requirements.acceptance: Only the fake base integrates gated commands and publishes synthetic odometry; no actuator path is present.
A future localization-loss simulation inhibits autonomous motion and records the loss.

requirements.statement: Design point-to-point navigation before autonomous operation.
requirements.acceptance: A future blocked-route simulation requests zero motion and records the blockage.

requirements.statement: Specify feedback and observation functions before hardware selection.
requirements.acceptance: An engineer approves measurable feedback and observation requirements before hardware selection.
